# Every Claude Code hook event, on a single-agent task and on a software project.
> mkdir -p app proj/sub && echo '{"remote_control": false}' > .home/settings.json
@set CLAUDE_ENV_FILE=$W/env
$ hook session-start <<< {"session_id":"s-1","cwd":"$W/app","transcript_path":"/nowhere.jsonl","source":"startup"}
@env env
$ status
$ hook prompt <<< {"session_id":"s-1","prompt":"/model opus"}
$ hook prompt <<< {"session_id":"s-1","prompt":"Fix the login bug — it loops forever when the session cookie expires and the user is sent back again and again\nmore detail"}
$ status
$ hook notification <<< {"session_id":"s-1","message":"Claude needs your permission to use Bash"}
$ agent list
$ hook post-tool <<< {"session_id":"s-1","tool_name":"Bash"}
$ agent list
$ hook post-tool <<< {"session_id":"s-1"}
> python3 -c "import sys,json;sys.argv=['x'];sys.path.insert(0,'$(dirname "$PYLACARTA")');import lacarta as l;from pathlib import Path;st=l.project_store('$LACARTA_PROJECT');exec('with st.edit() as s: l.add_message(s, \"Also check the logout path\"); l.add_message(s, \"And the tests\")')"
$ status
$ hook post-tool <<< {"session_id":"s-1"}
$ hook post-tool <<< {"session_id":"s-1"}
> python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'$(dirname "$PYLACARTA")');import lacarta as l;st=l.project_store('$LACARTA_PROJECT');exec('with st.edit() as s: l.add_message(s, \"One more thing\")')"
$ hook stop <<< {"session_id":"s-1"}
$ hook stop <<< {"session_id":"s-1"}
$ agent list
$ ask --title "Still needed?"
$ hook session-start <<< {"session_id":"s-1","cwd":"$W/app","transcript_path":"","source":"resume"}
$ hook session-end <<< {"session_id":"s-1","reason":"prompt_input_exit"}
$ status
$ hook session-start <<< {"session_id":"s-1","cwd":"$W/app","transcript_path":"","source":"resume"}
$ status
# A session in a software project joins it as the orchestrator.
@unset LACARTA_PROJECT
$ --root proj init --name "Proj"
> : > env
$ hook session-start <<< {"session_id":"s-2","cwd":"$W/proj/sub","transcript_path":"","source":"startup"}
> cat env
$ --root proj agent list
$ hook session-end <<< {"session_id":"s-2"}
$ --root proj agent list
# A session nobody registered (hooks installed mid-session) registers on its first event.
$ hook prompt <<< {"session_id":"s-3","cwd":"$W/proj","prompt":"hello"}
$ --root proj status
$ hook prompt <<< not json
> cat .home/hooks.log | grep -c prompt || true
